## 🎯 How System Understands User Requirements

### **Step 1: Location Detection**
```
Customer mentions: "goa" or "candolim" or "airport" or "beach"
AI identifies: Goa spas
AI asks: "Which Goa location - Candolim Beach, Dabolim Airport, or Tiswadi?"
```

### **Step 2: Service Understanding**
```
Customer says: "couple massage" or "romantic" or "anniversary"
AI extracts: Couple services needed
AI shows: Couple options at requested location with pricing
```

### **Step 3: Budget Assessment**
```
Customer says: "expensive" or "cheap" or "budget"
AI responds: Shows range, mentions discounts, highlights value
```

### **Step 4: Interest Level**
```
Interested: Provides details, helps book
Hesitant: Gentle persuasion, shows benefits
Not Interested: Graceful exit, stops messaging
```

## 🚀 To Add More Spa Centers

### **Just edit ONE file:**
`backend/src/scripts/seed-multi-spa-centers.ts`

### **Copy this template:**
```typescript
{
  spaName: 'Your Spa Name',
  locationName: 'Area/Branch',
  address: 'Full address',
  city: 'City name',
  contactNumber: 'Phone',
  whatsappNumber: 'WhatsApp',
  website: 'https://spaadvisor.in/',
  timings: {
    weekdays: 'Timings',
    weekends: 'Timings'
  },
  amenities: ['List', 'Facilities'],
  services: [
    {
      name: 'Service Name',
      description: 'Description',
      prices: [{ duration: 60, price: 2999 }],
      benefits: ['Benefit 1']
    }
  ],
  offers: ['Offer 1'],
  active: true
},
```

### **Run command:**
```bash
cd backend
npx ts-node src/scripts/seed-multi-spa-centers.ts
```

**Done!** System auto-generates all Q&A! ✅
